caption.text:
Presented by @Rolex. Welcome to Africa 🌍 Africa Earth’s Wild Home takes you deep into the heart of our wildest continent, bringing you closer to its animals, landscapes, and the people watching over it than ever before.

Through its partnership with the National Geographic Society and as part of its Perpetual Planet Initiative, #Rolex supports expeditions exploring and protecting remarkable places around the world, a selection of which are featured in Africa Earth’s Wild Home. #PerpetualPlanet

Africa Earth’s Wild Home, narrated by @wunmimosaku, premieres Friday, October 2 at 8/7c on National Geographic. Streaming next day on @DisneyPlus and @hulu.

caption.text:
Video and photos by @babaktafreshi | On Tuesday morning I photographed a celestial spectacle right in my backyard, near Boston. Hidden behind the moon for an hour, Jupiter reappeared from the dark night side of the moon, like a sparkling diamond. The rare phenomenon is called occultation. 

Slide 1: timelapse videos of the scene through a 600mm telephoto lens (cropped). Note the four lined up Galilean Moons of Jupiter. 
Slide 2: Moon is departing away from the alignment in twilight. 
Slide 3: An HDR image (3 exposures) to reveal the lunar details in both its bright dayside and the faint earthshine glow on the night side of the moon. 
Slide 4: A longer 30-second exposure on a star tracker has overexposed the moon to reveal the background starry sky.
